ns2:course.label: Introduction to Naval Science
ns2:course.description: Naval organization and management practices examined within the context of the naval service, command and control, organization for logistics, service and support, functions and services of major components of the Navy and Marine Corps, and shipboard organization with emphasis on management and leadership functions. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. No prerequisite for non-NROTC students.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. No prerequisite for non-NROTC students.
